active_loop.initialization: Within each class and review choose the row minimizing SHA-256(review UTF-8, NUL, canonical record identity), positive first then negative.
active_loop.refit: After each selected batch, refit from scratch on every observed row.
active_loop.ties: Stable descending score, then canonical record order.

arms.R0_L0: candidate TF-IDF representation and SGD log-loss balanced learner
arms.R0_L1: candidate TF-IDF representation and pinned u4 LinearSVC learner/balancer
arms.R1_L0: pinned u4 TF-IDF representation and candidate learner

custody_design.rationale: V6's external custodian is unavailable. V7 does not self-certify independence; it obtains the scientifically useful public execution while keeping independent reproduction as a strengthening gate rather than wasting local compute on signatures.
custody_design.required_disclosure: Same-workspace design and execution; public historical ASReview simulations exist for the named source family; no exact V7 result was opened before this freeze.

decision_rule.cannot_check: Any frozen file, source byte, population hash, label map, both-class check, complete-order check, or implementation binding fails.
decision_rule.public_performance_adverse: If the binding and population pass but any C1-C6 or G3-G6 performance gate fails, preserve every effect and issue the adverse V7 successor terminal.
decision_rule.public_performance_pass: If every C1-C6 and G3-G6 performance gate passes, issue only the exact-family public-development pass terminal; independent confirmation and broad superiority remain unavailable.

coprimary: unweighted mean learner/balancer main effect on CRE20
unweighted mean learner/balancer main effect on R@10
estimands.full_candidate_minus_u4: Per review R0_L0 minus R1_L1, then unweighted mean.

forbidden_claims: population-wide, domain-general, workflow-general, or source-general superiority
causal mechanism identification beyond the frozen 2x2 contrast
deletion or reversal of V3-V6 adverse terminals
post-outcome review deletion, endpoint substitution, tuning, or gate relaxation

gates.C2_CRE20_SIGN: learner/balancer CRE20 effect strictly positive in at least 12/14 reviews
gates.C4_R10_SIGN: learner/balancer R@10 effect strictly positive in at least 12/14 reviews

label.operational_semantics: expert_inclusion is treated as the source-named binary expert screening decision; V7 does not claim an independently validated universal construct.

metrics.R@q: relevant rows among the first max(1,ceil(q*N_r)) divided by P_r for q in 0.05,0.10,0.20
metrics.WSS95: 0.95 minus the smallest fraction screened attaining ceil(0.95*P_r) relevant rows

outcome_access_status_at_freeze: NO KIFMS LABEL VALUES, CLASS COUNTS, SEEDS, V7 ORDERS, ARM METRICS, OR COMPARATIVE OUTCOMES ACCESSED

population.rule: Reconstruct the exact V6 label-blind population. Because V6 records exactly one external content exclusion, enumerate the single outcome-blind deletion and require a unique candidate reproducing every frozen per-review and union content/PMID hash.
population.source: 14 exact OSF vt3n4 revision-one CSVs, CC-BY-4.0
population.unit: review decision; unweighted across all fourteen; never row pooled
